non_claims: Galloyl positions on the glucose and ester versus depside linkage are not resolved
The polyol (glucose) and the galloyl count are decided by the precursor composition
Monogalloyl glucoses are outside the series: their MS2 shows 169 and cross-ring ions but no 152 or 170 loss (Bai 2022 Table 1; Tan 2011 compound 8)

notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author): the gallic acid loss (170) is the galloyl loss (152) plus H2O, so two of the three counted ions can be one parent-daughter channel.

competitors.note: other hydroxybenzoyl hexose esters lose their acid but give no gallate ion
